responsibility: Provides out-of-line implementations for Rust AST path and generic-argument nodes. It owns stringification of generic arguments, path segments, simple and qualified path forms, conversions between path representations such as `PathPattern`/`TypePath` to `SimplePath`, disambiguation of ambiguous generic arguments into const or type AST nodes, construction of trait bounds from type paths, and the visitor dispatch hooks for these classes, making it the main operational support file for name/path syntax in the Rust AST.
same_name_distinction: Provides the out-of-line behavior for path AST classes declared in `rust-path.h`—notably stringification, path conversion/disambiguation helpers, trait-bound creation, and visitor dispatch—whereas the header owns the path and generic-argument type definitions themselves.
